title: The door of the ark (Genesis 6:16) and Jesus: "I am the door" (John 10:9)
summary: Genesis 6:16 with 'door' highlighted in brown and 'ark' with 'ar' in red, set beside John 10:9 where Jesus says "I am the door; if anyone enters through Me, he will be saved", signed yeshua ישוע Jesus; 'door', 'I am' and 'Me' are colour-coded.

text.text: 16 “You shall make a window for the ark, and finish it to a cubit from the top; and set the door of the ark in the side of it; you shall make it with lower, second, and third decks.
9 "I am the door; if anyone enters through Me, he will be saved, and will go in and out and find pasture.

uncertain: 'door' appears in brown in both verses; 'I am' and 'Me' are red; the colours are not explained on the slide. Greek header written as shown: Ἰωάνης.
